js: const L=window.__wolLearn; const z={ae:'amazon',ah:'amazon',ge:'grove',gh:'grove',re:'reef',rh:'reef',xe:'all',xh:'all'}; const out=[]; for (const lv of ['easy','hard']) { const c={amazon:0,grove:0,reef:0,all:0}; let rounds=0, lop=0; for (let k=0;k<60;k++){ const r=L._round(lv,'both'); rounds++; const zs=new Set(); for (const q of r){ if (!q.qid||!q.qid.startsWith('qb-')) continue; const zz=z[q.qid.slice(3,5)]; c[zz]++; zs.add(zz);} if (zs.size<2) lop++; } out.push(lv+' both x'+rounds+': '+Object.entries(c).map(([k,v])=>k+' '+v).join(', ')+' · rounds with one place only: '+lop); } out.join(' | ')

(async()=>{ const L=window.__wolLearn, $=(s)=>document.querySelector('#wol-learn '+s), sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const res=[]; for (const [lv,b,n] of [['hard','reef',14],['easy','grove',22],['easy','both',12]]) { const st0=(L._state().seen||[]).filter(x=>x.startsWith('qb-')); const asked=[]; for (let k=0;k<n;k++){ L._go('quiz',{level:lv,biome:b}); await sleep(60); for (let i=0;i<10;i++){ const o=$('.wl-opt'); o&&o.click(); await sleep(15); const nx=$('.wl-fb [data-wl=next]'); nx&&nx.click(); await sleep(15);} const s=(L._state().seen||[]); asked.push(...s.slice(-10).filter(x=>x.startsWith('qb-'))); } const rep=asked.length-new Set(asked).size; res.push(lv+'/'+b+' rounds '+n+' bank asked '+asked.length+' repeats '+rep); } return res.join(' | '); })()
